title: HDB Flats Foreclosed and Put on Auction due to Mortgage Defaults in Last Five Years
what_it_is: HDB Flats Foreclosed and Put on Auction due to Mortgage Defaults in Last Five Years

sections.label: HDB flat buyback and resale
sections.summary: HDB does not buy back flats or keep records of such requests; owners past the minimum occupation period may sell in the open market.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB does not buy back flats from flat owners and does not keep records of requests by flat owners who wish to sell their flats to HDB.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: HDB flat owners who have met the minimum occupation period may sell their flats in the open market.

sections.label: Insufficient proceeds for CPF refund
sections.summary: From January 2013 to November 2017, 6% of HDB flats sold in the open market gave lessees insufficient proceeds for a full CPF refund.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: On the Member's fourth question, from January 2013 to November 2017, 6% of the HDB flats sold in the open market generated insufficient proceeds for the lessees to make a full Central Provident Fund (CPF) refund.
